input:
scenery, no humans, an elevated urban interchange platform at the outer edge of a futuristic city in winter. A broad continuous walkable platform of matte engineered stone and concrete. Layered city buildings and elevated rail infrastructure in the distance. A restrained modern metal canopy with narrow supporting columns only at the extreme left and right edges. A few warm amber station lights, snow gathered only along the platform edges.

One complete side-view game battle environment for a 2D anime card battle game. A tangible, grounded urban place with believable weight-bearing architecture, clear construction, material thickness and contact between the canopy, columns and platform.

Single wide horizontal landscape image, no panels or storyboard. A calm side-on camera with a continuous horizontal fighting surface, not a deep view down a corridor. The platform rear edge is at about 56 percent of the canvas height; its front edge is at about 73 percent; the future character footline is around 68 percent. Keep the central 80 percent of the image unobstructed for combat, with quiet negative space behind future figures and HUD. Canopy eaves and narrow supports frame only the extreme edges. Show distant sky, city and rails as distinct overlapping depth planes. The platform has a visible solid fascia and structural base; it is not a floating slab. Restrained asymmetric composition, clear large silhouettes and broad connected masses of light and shade.

Cold cyan-gray winter sky and steel-blue architectural shadow masses, with a few restrained warm amber lamps. Hand-painted 2D material design: matte mineral paving, painted structural metal and thin wet ice have distinct broad painted responses. Subtle icy damp reflections only on a few flat ground planes, snow only at edges. Use economical opaque brush planes and selective crisp structural edges, with quieter softer distant shapes. Rich spatial depth and clear contact shadows without dense texture or small scratches. Keep the city readable instead of dissolving the whole image into uniform gray mist.

0.9::quasarcake::, 0.5::rella::, 0.4::gomzi::, 0.3::piromizu::

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
